story_title: Good Manners at the Dinner Table
task_instruction: Rewrite each sentence in the opposite voice: change active sentences to passive and passive sentences to active.
paragraphs: A family is teaching the children polite table manners before a special dinner. Their mother begins with simple examples. {{red:Guests use a napkin during the meal.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:The table is set by the children before dinner.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:Everyone keeps their elbows off the table.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:The soup is served by their father.}} {{mask_4}}

The family talks about sharing food and speaking politely. {{red:Children pass the bread to other guests.}} {{mask_5}} {{red:The water glasses are filled by Grandma.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:People use the word "please" when they ask for something.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:The vegetables are offered by the host.}} {{mask_8}}

During dinner, the parents explain how to behave at the table. {{red:Guests respect the person who is speaking.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:The plates are cleared by the children after the meal.}} {{mask_10}} {{red:Everyone thanks the cook for dinner.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:The leftovers are stored by their mother.}} {{mask_12}}

The children remember the advice as they help their family. {{red:People wash their hands before a meal.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:The dessert is brought to the table by their father.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:Guests share the dessert after everyone has eaten.}} {{mask_15}} {{red:The chairs are pushed in by the children.}} {{mask_16}}

After dinner, the family reviews the good manners they practiced. {{red:The children wash the serving dishes.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:The dining room is cleaned by the whole family.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:Everyone puts their napkin beside their plate.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:The tablecloth is folded by Grandma.}} {{mask_20}} The family agrees that kindness and consideration make a meal pleasant for everyone.

mask_1.target: A napkin is used by guests during the meal.

mask_2.target: The children set the table before dinner.

mask_3.target: Elbows are kept off the table by everyone.

mask_5.target: The bread is passed to other guests by children.

mask_7.target: The word "please" is used when people ask for something.

mask_9.target: The person who is speaking is respected by guests.

mask_10.target: The children clear the plates after the meal.

mask_11.target: The cook is thanked for dinner by everyone.

mask_13.target: Hands are washed by people before a meal.

mask_14.target: Their father brings the dessert to the table.

mask_15.target: The dessert is shared by guests after everyone has eaten.

mask_16.target: The children push in the chairs.

mask_17.target: The serving dishes are washed by the children.

mask_18.target: The whole family cleans the dining room.

mask_19.target: Napkins are put beside their plates by everyone.
